relationships.subject: kallikrein
relationships.evidence_quote: The elevation of vasodilatory bradykinin (BK) due to kallikrein activity reduces preload and afterload

relationships.subject: kinin-kallikrein system
relationships.evidence_quote: Importantly, prolonged KKS activation resulting from volume overload and tissue stretch contributes to cardiac collagen loss.

key_findings: Review: prolonged KKS activation contributes to cardiac collagen loss and remodeling in heart failure; KKS blockade proposed as a strategy.
